newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate stable in balanced trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate stable in balanced trade.

text.p: Croatian average lending rate was stable at 10.5 percent in brisk, balanced trade on Monday, dealers said.
Supply of 60.1 million kuna ($10.5 million) was very slightly overshot by demand, leaving two banks empty-handed. New interbank deals were struck at a steady call money rate of 10.5 percent.
Insurers rolled over one-week funds at 9.0 percent and one smaller two-week loan at 15 percent.
The kuna midrates for Tuesday eased to 5.8613 against the dollar and to 3.5679 against the German mark. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075 ($ = 5.731 Croatian Kuna)
